lessons_used: Predictions were mostly too high for neutral or negative changes, but too low for winning tests.
Sign-in reorder changes were helpful in 2 tests, while 2 tests showed no clear effect.
Adoption redesign changes showed no clear effect in 2 tests and made performance worse in 2 tests.
Finish new_screen changes made performance worse in 2 tests and showed no clear effect in 1 test.
No clear effect was seen for home new_flow changes across 2 tests.
Evidence is still thin for choose_path reorder and sign_in notification (1 test each), while adoption new_flow had mixed results across 2 tests (1 worse, 1 won).

candidates.why: Finish step conversion drops to 64.8% and takes a median 395s; support emails also indicate users are unclear on how to summon or interact with their pet.

home_intro.headline: Your Desktop Companion is Ready to Meet You!
